Tip.AbDex: Dexterity — bonus (score ÷ 6, rounded down) adds to Accuracy and to Dexterity-based class checks (e.g. Scout lock-picking, Ranger first aid).
Tip.AbAgi: Agility — bonus adds to Evasion and Agility-based checks such as Scout Initiative. Your normal Movement Speed equals your Agility score.
Tip.AbStr: Strength — bonus adds to weapon damage. Weapons and armor list a minimum Strength needed to use them.
Tip.AbVit: Vitality — Max HP = Vitality + Adventurer Level × 3. Fortitude = Adventurer Level + Vitality bonus.
Tip.AbInt: Intelligence — bonus adds to Magic Power for every spellcasting class and to Sage knowledge checks.
Tip.AbMnd: Spirit — Max MP = Spirit + total magic-class levels × 3. Willpower = Adventurer Level + Spirit bonus.
Tip.Base: Racial base values (Technique / Body / Mind), shared by each pair of abilities.
Tip.Roll: Value rolled for this ability at character creation (A–F).
Tip.Growth: Points gained through Growth after adventures.
Tip.GrowthRoll: After an adventure roll 2d6: each die names an ability (1 Dex, 2 Agi, 3 Str, 4 Vit, 5 Int, 6 Spi). Choose one of the two and raise it by 1.
Tip.AdvLevel: Adventurer Level = your highest class level. Used for Fortitude, Willpower, Max HP and many checks.
Tip.Exp: Experience points spent on classes / total experience earned.
Tip.HP: Hit Points. At 0 or less you must make death checks.
Tip.MP: Magic Points, spent to cast spells and use some abilities.
Tip.MaxMod: Bonus added to the calculated maximum.
Tip.Accuracy: Accuracy check: 2d6 + weapon class level + Dexterity bonus + weapon accuracy modifier. Click to roll.
Tip.Damage: Damage: roll 2d6 on the weapon's Power table (Power = which row, Crit = roll this or higher to roll again) + Bonus (weapon class level + Strength bonus). Click to roll.
Tip.Evasion: Evasion check: 2d6 + Fighter / Grappler / Fencer level + Agility bonus + armor/shield evasion. Click to roll.
Tip.Defense: Defense: subtracted from physical damage you take.
Tip.Fortitude: Fortitude check (resist poison, disease etc.): 2d6 + Adventurer Level + Vitality bonus. Click to roll.
Tip.Willpower: Willpower check (resist spells, curses etc.): 2d6 + Adventurer Level + Spirit bonus. Click to roll.
Tip.Move: Limited Move (3 m) / Normal Move (= Agility) / Full Move (Agility × 3), in metres.
Tip.HitWeapon: Weapon used by the Accuracy and Damage boxes.
Tip.AttackSkill: Class used for Accuracy and Damage.
Tip.Fumble: Fumbles (double 1s) this session — each automatic failure grants 50 experience points.
Tip.MagicPower: Magic Power = class level + Intelligence bonus. Click to roll a spellcasting check.
Tip.SchoolMod: Modifier to this school's casting checks.

Feats.Title: Combat Feats
Feats.Locked: Locked: this slot opens at adventurer level {level}. Raise a class to that level to use it.
Feats.Hint: Drag a combat feat onto a level slot, or press Put in slot. Feats in a slot are active.
Feats.SlotTip: Click to show in chat · drag to move · × to take out (Shift-click opens the feat)
Feats.ShowTip: Click to show in chat (Shift-click opens the feat)
Feats.EmptyTip: Click to choose a feat (or drag one here)
Feats.Remove: Take out (keeps the feat on the sheet)
Feats.UnassignedTip: Feats you own that are not active. Drag one onto a slot above.
Feats.UnassignedEmpty: Drag a feat here to take it out of its slot
Feats.AssignTip: Put this feat in the first free level slot
Feats.AutoTip: Feats your classes give you for free. They are always active.
Feats.NoFreeSlot: No free level slot for {item}. Take a feat out first, or drag it onto a slot to swap.
Feats.ActivateTip: On a character: ticking puts this feat in the first free level slot (and turns on its effects); unticking takes it out.
Feats.PickTitle: Level {level} slot: choose a combat feat
Feats.PickNone: All your combat feats are already in a slot. Add a new feat from the Items sidebar or a compendium, then click the slot again.

Belt.Title: Consumables Belt
Belt.Full: The belt is full - untick something first.
Belt.Hint: Click a tick to use one, Shift-click to restore one.
Belt.OnlyConsumables: Only Consumable items can go on the belt.
Belt.Cleaned: Belt: removed non-consumable entries on {n} actor(s).
Belt.ShowHint: Post this item to chat. Nothing is used up.
Belt.NotConsumable: {item} is not a Consumable, so it can't go on the belt. Only items of type Consumable can (make one with New Consumable in the inventory).
Belt.EmptyTip: Click to choose a consumable (or drag one here)
Belt.PickNone: No consumables in this inventory yet. Use New Consumable in the inventory to make one, then click the slot again.

EquipCard.MinStr: Minimum Strength {req} — your effective Strength is {str}.
EquipCard.PanHint: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

SB.ModeHint: Play: roll from the sheet. Edit: change values.
SB.FixedHint: fixed = posts the value to chat
SB.GmOnlyHint: No-damage spells: whisper the description to the GM (on) or post it publicly (off).
SB.NoSpells: No spells found for this school and level.
SB.InventoryHint: drag items here — roll to chat
SB.InventoryEmpty: Drag weapons, armour or gear here.
SB.LootHint: Roll 2d6 on the loot table and whisper the drop to the GMs

Card.DiceTip: The two six-sided dice you rolled and their sum. The sum is looked up on the Power table.
Card.TableResultTip: Damage read from the Power table for the dice sum (before the bonus).
Card.BonusTip: Flat damage added after the table lookup (extra damage, ability bonus, etc.).
Card.CritsTip: Table result of each roll. More than one means the attack crit and rolled again.
Card.HalfTip: Halve the damage (rounded up), e.g. for a successful resistance.
Card.HalfRoundUpTip: Halve the table result plus bonus, rounded up, then add later modifiers.
Card.IgnoreCritsTip: Recalculate using only the first roll, as if the attack did not crit.
Card.TargetTip: Select tokens on the map (click or drag a box; targets work if nothing is selected), then click here to set who this applies to.
Card.LiveTargetTip: Apply buttons hit the tokens you have selected (or targeted) when you click. No extra step needed.
Card.NoTarget: No target. Select tokens on the map
Card.NoTokensWarn: Select tokens on the map first
Card.pdTip: Physical: reduced by the target's Defense.
Card.mdTip: Magic: not reduced by Defense; magic resistances and effects apply.
Card.cdTip: Fixed: applied exactly as shown, nothing reduces it.
Card.hrTip: Hits HP: the damage comes off the target's HP.
Card.mrTip: Hits MP: the damage comes off the target's MP instead of HP.
Card.ApplyDamageTip: Physical damage: the target's Defense is subtracted. Applies to the tokens you have selected (or targeted, if none are selected) when you click.
